**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Server clientOnly erasure requires an inline importer and inline selector or undefined
```

## How to fix

Pass clientOnly an inline arrow importer and, optionally, an inline selector: `clientOnly(() => import("./map"), (m) => m.Map)`; no variables or spreads.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { clientOnly } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
declare const imp: any;
export const X = clientOnly(imp);
```

```tsx prefer
import { clientOnly } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export const X = clientOnly(() => import("./x"), (m) => m.X);
```

## When it is reported

Server target.
